protocol: Glue-lite on native MTP K2 async: five added environment keys, all switches off by default; no argument change
code_identity: The module code (AST without the top-level docstring) equals the reviewed module used by the in-boot A/B packet; only two docstring lines differ (repository references instead of campaign paths).

GLM_GLUE_ROUTER_BF16.removes: 75 router-logit BF16->FP32 casts per target forward (one per MoE layer)
GLM_GLUE_ROUTER_BF16.exactness: the fused CUDA grouped_topk single-group kernel widens each BF16 logit to FP32 before any arithmetic, so the ids and weights are those of the cast input; armed only for E256 / one group / top-8 / sigmoid with an FP32 correction bias / renormalize / scaling 1.0 or 2.5

GLM_GLUE_MOE_WS.removes: 75 torch.zeros lock-workspace allocations per target forward
GLM_GLUE_MOE_WS.exactness: Marlin MoE resets every lock it used at the end of a completed call (barrier_release reset), so one persistent zeroed workspace reused in stream order sees the same zeros; preallocated at model load, a capture without it fails closed, other streams fall back to the stock allocation

GLM_GLUE_DSA_IDX_CACHE.removes: 57 index conversions and their full_like(-1) per target forward on the static skip_topk layers
GLM_GLUE_DSA_IDX_CACHE.exactness: a skip layer of the same forward reuses the (slots, counts) of the last computing layer only when every pointer, shape, stride, dtype and flag of the inputs is identical; any other MLA forward invalidates; the MTP model is never armed

expected_saving_ms_per_cycle.basis: kernel plus launch-edge time of the removed launches in profiled rank-0 traces (62 cycles); not a measurement of the switch

status: staged, default off: GPU gates written and self-checked on CPU, not run on a GPU; no fleet A/B yet
